country.evidence_quote: This website is aimed at anyone interested in universities of applied sciences (UAS) studies in Finland, including study counsellors and those involved in higher education application processes. On these pages, you’ll find information on student selection for English-taught programmes leading to a UAS degree. You can also explore the content of UAS studies offered in English.
